Solution : The given equations are
$$2y + 5z = 16......... (1)$$
$$y - 2z = -1.........(2)$$
From ( 2 ) we get, $$y = 2z - 1......... (3)$$
Putting the value of $$y$$ in equation (1) we get, $$2(2z - 1) + 5z = 16$$
or, $$4z - 2 + 5z = 16$$
or, $$9z = 16 + 2$$
or, $$9z = 18$$
or, $$z = \frac{18}{9}$$
$$\therefore z = 2$$
Here, putting the value of $$z$$ in (3) we get
$$y = 2 \times 2 - 1$$
$$= 4 - 1$$
$$\therefore y = 3$$
$$\therefore$$ Required solution is $$(y, z) = (3, 2)$$.
